Accounts are coming soon. Krunk works fully without one; an account will only be needed for sync.

Check the code

Check that your other screen shows this code, then approve there:

If the codes are different, deny it on the other screen.

On your signed-in browser, open Account → Devices & sync → Add a device to make a new code.

To sync a phone, use the Krunk app (the Android app is coming). Signing in here only opens your account page in this browser.

KruxSYS

Krunk is a KruxSYS product: a fast, private browser for Windows, with a preview for Android. Open source (MIT), no telemetry.

Bundles Chromium through the Chromium Embedded Framework, and filter lists by EasyList and uBlock Origin; see the notices in the download.
